notes: The mirror image of shotgun_4wr_dive_option, and the play keep_gap was added for (SS93). The author's own description: "the QB is reading the playside DE or OLB, if he goes inside it's a sweep to HB, if he follows the back the QB pulls it and runs into the A gap." So the give leg sweeps outside (target_gap C_R) and the keep attacks the interior (keep_gap A_R) -- the opposite assignment of gaps to legs from the Dive Option, fielded from the identical formation and blocking look so the two disguise each other. Two read_carry legs, no pitch back, the same shape pistol_read_option and shotgun_4wr_speed_option already use. The give leg takes no downhill snap velocity here, because target_gap is not an interior gap -- see run_play_state.dart: a sweeping back handed a dive back's head start arrives at an unblocked edge at full speed and measured 10.35 yards a carry.
